statements.status_notes: Fixed upstream in Perl 5.42.3. The 5.42.3 perldelta lists CVE-2026-57432 (buffer overflow in S_measure_struct for pack and unpack) under Security, and this package builds the upstream perl 5.42.3 release. Release notes: https://github.com/Perl/perl5/blob/v5.42.3/pod/perldelta.pod

The DHI perl APK backports the upstream S_measure_struct overflow guards from https://github.com/Perl/perl5/commit/5f7eb6bbbe0510964e3fb1d6bb691e5445913e55 and https://github.com/Perl/perl5/commit/40754edc72dd3e513d758153c0e2f0215897740e. The patched package croaks when a pack/unpack structure size would overflow SSize_t and uses overflow-safe bit/nibble length math. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-57432

The DHI perl APK backports the upstream Perl_study_chunk trie overflow guard from https://github.com/Perl/perl5/commit/03f74bbbd3a68350d926ee93d56ee4808c28c4c7. The patched package skips trie optimization when the start-to-tail delta would overflow a 16-bit field. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-13221
